import pandas as pd

def load_and_validate_source(path):
    # Load the CSV file
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly as expected and in correct order
    expected_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]
    # Reorder columns if necessary
    df = df[expected_columns]
    
    # Convert data types to match target schema
    df['tripduration'] = df['tripduration'].astype(int)
    df['starttime'] = df['starttime'].astype(str)
    df['stoptime'] = df['stoptime'].astype(str)
    df['start station id'] = df['start station id'].astype(int)
    df['start station name'] = df['start station name'].astype(str)
    df['start station latitude'] = df['start station latitude'].astype(float)
    df['start station longitude'] = df['start station longitude'].astype(float)
    df['end station id'] = df['end station id'].astype(int)
    df['end station name'] = df['end station name'].astype(str)
    df['end station latitude'] = df['end station latitude'].astype(float)
    df['end station longitude'] = df['end station longitude'].astype(float)
    df['bikeid'] = df['bikeid'].astype(int)
    df['usertype'] = df['usertype'].astype(str)
    df['birth year'] = df['birth year'].astype(int)
    df['gender'] = df['gender'].astype(int)
    
    return df

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    ]
    
    # Load all source dataframes
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = load_and_validate_source(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)
    
    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one target dataframe
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Final validation: ensure target schema and dtypes are correct
    target_schema = {
        'tripduration': int,
        'starttime': str,
        'stoptime': str,
        'start station id': int,
        'start station name': str,
        'start station latitude': float,
        'start station longitude': float,
        'end station id': int,
        'end station name': str,
        'end station latitude': float,
        'end station longitude': float,
        'bikeid': int,
        'usertype': str,
        'birth year': int,
        'gender': int
    }
    for col, dtype in target_schema.items():
        target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(dtype)
    
    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
